verdict.rationale: xAI publishes a documented public REST API for Grok. It covers a quickstart, text generation, streaming, structured outputs, reasoning parameters, and image and video generation, and a probe confirmed a live OpenAPI spec at docs.x.ai/openapi.json and an llms.txt. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of driving the product via the API, and evidence that consumer-app features (connectors, Grok Bot) are exposed through the API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
